details.text: The extension http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/elementdefinition-maxValueSet|5.3.0-ballot is deprecated with the note: 'Use additionalBinding extension or element instead'

The Binding on the type slicer Observation.value[x] applies to all its slices, but it only makes sense for some of its types, so it has no effect on the slices for boolean, integer, Ratio, SampledData, time, dateTime, Period

The MaxLength on the type slicer Observation.value[x] applies to all its slices, but it only makes sense for some of its types, so it has no effect on the slices for Quantity, CodeableConcept, boolean, Range, Ratio, SampledData, Period
